journal_dm:
THE LANTERN BELOW • A starter adventure for four level-1 heroes
Estimated play time: 45–90 minutes. Read each boxed-style passage aloud in your own words. Numbers are suggestions; reward creative solutions.

1 / THE HOOK
The lantern keeper Elin disappeared while investigating blue light at the old ruins. Without the lantern, boats cannot safely reach Reedfall. The village offers 40 gp total for Elin’s return. No prior campaign knowledge is needed.

Read aloud: “Rain beads on ancient stone. Somewhere beyond the broken gate, a bell rings once. A warm light slips beneath the door, then vanishes.”
Ask each player: Why did your hero agree to help? Select your tokens and let everyone practice one skill roll.

2 / THE OUTER COURTYARD
Two goblins guard the approach. They are frightened scavengers, not loyal villains. A hero can bargain with food or make a DC 12 Persuasion check to learn that “the bones woke up.” A DC 12 Stealth group check can bypass them. If combat starts, roll initiative. They flee or surrender after one falls. This is an introductory fight; avoid overwhelming new players.

3 / THE FLOODED ARCHIVE
Reveal the eastern chamber with the fog brush. A skeleton guards a sealed niche. The skeleton is inactive until the niche opens. A DC 12 Investigation check finds a brass key in the shallow pool. A DC 12 Religion or Arcana check identifies a protective ward. Cleverly restoring its sun symbol quiets the skeleton without a fight. The DM describes the ward and resolves alternatives; the map has no automatic puzzle scripting.

4 / THE KEEPER
Elin shelters in the southeast storeroom. Her ankle is hurt, but she is conscious. The blue light comes from a cracked lantern lens, not a monster. A DC 10 Medicine check, healing magic, or careful support gets her walking. The chest contains the lens, a handwritten river chart, 12 gp and a potion of healing (2d4+2 HP). Add rewards to inventories manually.

5 / HOMEWARD
Move to Mosswater Crossing. Ask how the party handles a slippery bridge and carries Elin across. A rope, teamwork or a DC 10 Athletics check are all reasonable. Failure causes a complication rather than ending the adventure. Finish at The Copper Finch, pay the party and ask each player what their hero does next. Use milestone advancement to level 2 if desired; update sheets manually.

DM SUPPORT
Use easy DC 10, medium DC 15, hard DC 20 as a baseline. Checks cannot do the impossible. A missed clue can reappear through an NPC. Take a pause whenever someone is unsure. Adjust fights for party size. Fog is manual, and special abilities, resistances and spell effects are DM-adjudicated.
journal_public:
THE LANTERN BELOW
The village of Reedfall needs its missing lantern keeper. Follow the old road, investigate the ruins, and bring Elin home.

Party objectives
• Find out what happened at the ruins.
• Recover Elin and the lantern lens.
• Return safely to Reedfall.

Shared notes
Write discoveries, NPC names, treasure and plans here. The DM can edit and publish this handout.
